Sandeep Lamichhane spins a match-winning tale with a sensational six-wicket haul!
Pokhara Avengers looked set to put up a challenging total, but Sandeep’s brilliant spell triggered a late collapse and helped restrict them to a modest score.
The Biratnagar Kings then held their nerve in the chase, securing a thrilling 4-wicket win with 4 balls to spare and adding two crucial points to their campaign!
